bear_assumptions: FY2028 revenue of USD 470 million at 5x enterprise value to revenue as RPO conversion or margin execution weakens; USD 200 million post-investment net cash after note obligations and capital needs; 405 million diluted shares including equity awards and other dilution.
base_assumptions: FY2028 revenue of USD 560 million at 9x enterprise value to revenue as recurring demand supports growth but capital intensity persists; USD 300 million post-investment net cash; 420 million diluted shares including RSUs, options and other dilution.
bull_assumptions: FY2028 revenue of USD 680 million at 15x enterprise value to revenue as retention, backlog conversion, margins and free cash flow improve; USD 600 million post-investment net cash; 450 million diluted shares including option, RSU and net convertible dilution.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower fresh price or stronger primary-evidence revenue and free-cash-flow path clears expected-return, base-return, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates and a current canonical relationship is accepted; downgrade the operating thesis if RPO or backlog conversion, retention, guidance, satellite reliability, government funding, liquidity or per-share economics weaken.
